content: Asgenfi n Nuɛman

Nuɛman, akumandar n řɛeskar n ujeǧid n Aram, tuɣa-t d ijj n weryaz ɣares ssumɛet zzat i wudem n sidis nnes u tuɣa ɣares ccan aṭṭas, maɣar zzayes i yiwi SIDI asenjem i Aram. Aryaz nni tuɣa d ijj n bu-teɣruḍt imeḥḍen, maca tuɣa dayes řbarṣ.
Tuɣa din bandiyyat zi Aram, iwyent-dd ict n tebřiɣt zi temmurt n Israil d tameḥbust. Tuɣa-tt txeddem i temɣart n Nuɛman.
Tenna i lallas: “Mři tuɣa sidi inu ɣar unabi di Samarya, xenni iři netta ad t issgenfa zi řbars nnes.”
Xenni yuyur wanita, ḥima ad t iḥaja i sidis nnes, inna: “Ammu d wammu i tessiweř tebřiɣt zi temmurt n Israil.”
Xenni inna ujeǧid n Aram: “Uyur din u necc ad ssekkeɣ ict n tebrat i ujeǧid n Israil.” Netta yuyur deg webrid uca iksi ɛecra talintat n nnuqart d setta-ařaf ciqlu n wureɣ d ɛecra n warruḍ icnan.
Netta issiweḍ tabrat i ujeǧid n Israil, ammu i yura: “Řexxu xenni, xzar, mařa tiweḍ-dd tebrat-a ɣarek, aqa necc ssekkeɣ-dd ɣarek ɛawed amsexxar inu Nuɛman, maḥend ad t tessgenfid zi řbarṣ nnes.”

Umi iɣra ujeǧid n Israil tabrat, icarreg arruḍ nnes, iřaɣa: “Necc maɣar ma d AREBBI ařami zemmareɣ ad sseddareɣ ijj n umettin ařami netta dd-issekk weryaz-a ɣari, maḥend ad t ssgenfiɣ zi řbarṣ nnes? Iwa, ssnem, u xzarem, aqa netta yarezzu ayi řesbab waha!”

Umi isřa Ilicaɛ, aryaz n AREBBI, belli ajeǧid n Israil icarreg arruḍ nnes, imsar aqa netta issekk ijj ɣar ujeǧid, ḥima ad as yini: “Mayemmi tcarrged arruḍ nnec? Ejj i-t ad ɣari dd-yas, ḥima xenni netta ad issen, aqa din ijj n unabi di Israil.”
Ammu dd-yusa Nuɛman ak-d iysan d ukarru nnes uca ibedd ɣar tewwart n taddart n Ilicaɛ.
Xenni issekk Ilicaɛ ijj n ureqqas ɣares, iqqar: “Uyur u ssird ixef nnec sebɛa n twařawin di L’Urdun, xenni ad tedweř arrimet nnec teggenfa uca cek ad tiřid d amezdag.”

Iffugem Nuɛman, uca yuyur, iqqar: “Xzar, necc nniɣ deg ixef inu: ‘Netta ad iffeɣ ɣar barra, ad ibedd din, maḥend ad iřaɣa Isem n SIDI, AREBBI nnes, uca ad issekk s ufus nnes amcan i dayes iǧan řbarṣ u ammu i ɣa iggenfa řbarṣ.’
Ma war iǧi Abana d Farfar, iɣezran n Dimacq, ḥsen x marra iɣezran n Israil? Ma war zemmareɣ ad dinni ssirdeɣ, ḥima ad zedgeɣ?” Netta inneqřeb uca yuyur, isɛar aṭṭas.
Imsexxaren nnes usin-dd ɣares, ssiwřen akides, nnan: “Baba, mři anabi nni ittar zzayek ca min iwɛaren, iři teggid t? I mařa inna xak ɛad: ‘Sird ixef nnec uca ad tdewřed cek tizdiged?’”
Xenni ihwa-dd ɣar L’Urdun uca isseɣḍeṣ ixef nnes sebɛa n twařawin di L’Urdun am mammec inna wawař n unabi n AREBBI uca tedweř arrimet nnes teggenfa am arrimet n ijj n uḥenjir u netta idweř izdig.

Xenni iɛqeb ɣar weryaz n AREBBI ak-d marra řɛeskar nnes uca yiweḍ din, ibedd zzat i wudem nnes, inna: “Xzar, řexxu ssneɣ, aqa war iǧi AREBBI mani ma x marra tammurt mɣir di Israil waha. Xenni řexxu, ɛafek, ksi ict n tarzeft zeg umsexxar nnec!”
Maca netta inna: “S tidett am iddar SIDI wenni umi beddeɣ zzat i wudem nnes, necc war kessiɣ walu!” U netta issḥeccem i-t, ḥima ad iksi ca, maca netta yugi.

Inna Nuɛman: “Mařa lla, iři xenni ad immewc i umsexxar nnec aṭṭas n ucař, anect zemmaren tnayen n iserdan ad arbun, maɣar amsexxar nnec war ittiwi ɛad taɣarṣt n wecmaḍ niɣ taɣarṣt i irebbiten inneɣni mɣir i SIDI waha.

Maca iři ad iɣfar SIDI i umsexxar nnec ta waha, mařa sidi inu ad yadef ɣar zzawect n Rimmun ḥima ad ibendeq am ittɛemmed dinni x uɣiř inu, aqa necc xenni ad bendqeɣ ammu di zzawect n Rimmun. Mařa ad bendqeɣ ammu di zzawect n Rimmun, iři ad iɣfar SIDI tamesřact nni i umsexxar nnec.”
Inna as: “Uyur di řehna!” U netta isafar tammurt, iggʷej xas ijj n webrid.

Inna Jiḥazi, amsexxar n Ilicaɛ, aryaz n AREBBI: “Xzar, sidi inu issɛizz x Naɛman, Aramiyu, maḥend ad iksi ca zeg ufus nnes zi min tuɣa i dd-yiwi netta. S tidett am iddar SIDI, necc ad t areddfeɣ deɣya uca ad zzayes ksiɣ ca!”
Jiḥazi yuyur, yardef Nuɛman. Umi Nuɛman iẓra, aqa netta yuzzeř awarni as, iḍra-dd zeg ukarru, maḥend akides imsagar, inna: “Mliḥ?”

Netta yarra-dd xas: “Mliḥ. Sidi inu issekk ayi-dd maḥend ad yini: ‘Aqa, ɣar řexxu ɛad usin-dd tnayen n iḥudriyyen zeg ayt n inabiyyen zeg idurar n Ifrayim. Ewc asen xenni ict n talint n nnuqart d tyuya n warruḍ icnan.’”

Inna Nuɛman: “Ɛafak, ksi zzayi tnayen talint n nnuqart.” Netta iḥeccem i-t u igga tnayen talint n nnuqart di tnayen n tecyarin uca iwca tnayen n warruḍ icnan i tnayen n imsexxaren nnes, inni ten yarbun ɣar zzat nnes.
Umi yiweḍ ɣar řgeɛɛdet, iksi ten zeg ifassen nsen uca innuffar i-ten di taddart. Ijja iryazen ad uyuren uca ffɣen nitni.
Awarni man aya yudef uca ibedd zzat i bab nnes. Ilicaɛ isseqsa t: “Manis dd-tusid, a Jiḥazi?” Uca netta yarra-dd: “Amsexxar nnec war dd-iffiɣ ca mani.”

Maca Ilicaɛ inna as: “Ma war tuɣi uř inu din iḥḍar umi dd-iḍra weryaz zeg ukarru nnes i umsagar akidek? Maɣar ma d řḥař ad tmenɛed nnuqart d warruḍ d tcejjura n zzitun d imarjaɛen n uḍiř d wuǧi d ifunasen d tfunasin d isemɣan d tiyya?
Řbarṣ n Nuɛman ad iřseq i řebda dayek u di zzariɛet nnec!” Xenni iffeɣ zi zzat i wudem nnes s řbarṣ, d acemřař am wedfeř.
